ns2:section.sectionText: Class sessions will be held on the following weekends: May 31 & June 1; June 7 & 8; June 14 & 15 and July 12 & 13. Friday sessions will meet 5:30-9:30pm CDT and Saturday sessions will meet from 8:00am - 4:00pm CDT. This course section is restricted to students in the Oak Brook program/cohort. Blackboard Collaborate may be used. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
